# Quarrendon QBR notes (Duluth)
**Date:** July 22, 2025  
**Attendees:** Thea Ramaswell (Quarrendon Freight Lines), me, Ilse Varga (dialed in first 15m)  
**Loc:** Duluth terminal conf room B

### Adoption by terminal
- **Duluth:** 100% on Pemberline Dock. Gate 3 kiosk scanner still dropping wifi on 2nd shift; IT swapping the AP on Thurs.
- **Superior:** Dispatchers fully off the old spreadsheet. Still seeing manual overrides on Doors 8–12 during the 05:00 cross-dock rush.
- **Twin Cities (Blaine):** Lagging on carrier self-check-in. Night yard leads skipping the Dock Detention Summary rpt and radioing spotters directly. Thea wants a 30-min refresher for the Blaine night crew.

### Commercials & Expansion
- Currently fully utilizing the 140-seat MSA across the current footprint.
- Thea wants to expand toward 185 seats to cover the extra yard clerks and spotter tablets.
- They are bringing the Fargo terminal onto Pemberline Dock next year—target go-live right before spring thaw.

### Action Items
- [ ] **Me:** Pull Blaine override logs (Doors 1–20) and send to Thea by Fri.
- [ ] **Me:** Schedule 2nd-shift training session w/ Blaine leads.
- [ ] **Thea:** Confirm headcount split for the new seats before we scope Fargo.
